title: Hatalarımı Cebime Koydum
author: Esat Zorkirişçi
description:
This is a story about mistakes, and the many ways we can learn to face them. 
Whenever our little narrator makes a mistake, she tucks it into her pocket and sets off in search of a four-leaf clover, remembering Mum’s words that every mistake is a chance to begin again. Along the way, she discovers that no two mistakes are quite alike: some smell like burnt cake, some flow like rivers from another person’s eyes, while others grow as high as mountains.
